hash_policy: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes after CRLF-to-LF normalization; no other whitespace normalization.

relevance_grades.0: Explicitly judged not relevant if present; no exhaustive negative labeling is claimed.
relevance_grades.1: A: broad background norm. C LexRel: binary same-relation weak positive, NOT low expert relevance.
relevance_grades.2: A: materially useful supplementary/boundary rule. C known-item: analogous issue with a substantive factual distinction.
relevance_grades.3: A: core rule for the stated issue. C known-item: direct matching curated source case.

curated_silver_non_exhaustive.description: Original hypothetical fact questions grounded in the repository rules and official 2020 Civil Code text; grades are curated judgments, not independent expert gold. Different applicable rules may remain unlabeled.

weak_relation_label_non_exhaustive.description: Preserve the 13 pre-existing natural-language topics; recompute qrels ONLY from independent relation annotations in the 9+96 pinned input records, trimming outer whitespace without semantic aliases. Exact for this label definition over 105 LexRel records, not exhaustive legal relevance over 156 candidates.

curated_known_item_silver_non_exhaustive.description: Paraphrased fact scenarios based on six already indexed SPC editorial summaries. Known-item retrieval checks, not held-out queries or independent similar-case gold. One sport-training analogy is additionally graded 2.

policies.runtime_input: Only query_text is submitted as user facts. Do not pass qrels, source_refs, domain, judgment_basis or target IDs to A/B/C. Score after retrieval.
policies.unjudged: Unlabeled candidates contribute gain 0 in this closed evaluation; this is a scoring convention, NOT a finding that they are legally irrelevant. Recall is recall of the annotated positives.
policies.isolation: Do not build case search text from relation-enriched title, cause, keywords, summary, reasoning, or qrels. The runner records the facts-only search view hash separately; no copied LexRel corpus is added by this benchmark.
policies.self_exclusion: SPC questions are paraphrased known-item scenarios rather than source-case-to-peer queries, so target cases remain eligible. exclude_ids is empty. Future source-case-to-peer protocols must exclude their own source ID before top-k.
policies.selection: Query topics and qrels were prepared without consulting retrieval ranks; this is a frozen diagnostic/development benchmark, not a statistically representative blinded test set.
policies.metric_groups: Report A, C relation-label and C known-item metrics separately. Gains 2^grade-1; Recall relevant iff grade>0. Mixed C/all scores, if emitted, are diagnostic aggregates with incompatible judgment semantics explicitly disclosed.
limitations: Seven domains with four A queries each do not exhaust 776 rules or 1260 articles.
Rule relevance is not proof of the rule's maturity, semantic completeness, applicability or the legal correctness of an eventual answer.
LexRel same-relation labels can overinclude cases that do not satisfy the full query and miss differently annotated but relevant cases.
Only 105 of 156 C candidates have LexRel relation labels; the other 51 are not hard negatives.
Six SPC tasks are known-item checks, so their scores can be easier than novel similar-case retrieval.
No author identity, bank account, contact information, raw LexRel case text or returned ranking is copied into these query/manifest files.
A later relevance adjudication should use pooled retrieval plus independent blinded reviewers and version the qrels before comparing systems.
